summary: modelmesh-runtime-adapter is a Kubernetes component. connecting to external services: azure-blob, gcs, grpc. 39 Python package dependencies (39 required), categories: 1 grpc, 1 numerical, 1 serialization, 2 ml-framework. with 360 operator config constants (14 env vars). references components: kserve (import).
repository_description: This repo contains the unified puller/runtime-adapter image of the sidecar containers which run in the ModelMesh Serving model server Pods. Take a look at the main ModelMesh Serving repo for more details.
